_notes.generate_only_after: Anton writes 'Generate image' in the chat AND `curl -sI` to a *.cloudfront.net URL returns 200 from the session environment.
_notes.model_rule: gpt_image_2_5, variant sunburst (higgsfield-image-pipeline Rule 1). No Nano Banana from a session.
_notes.resolution_rule: 2k for slots rendered >= 1200 px wide or 21:9 (hero, headers, vision, statement, OG); 1k for cards (<= 800 px wide).

high_slots.home-hero: LCP element of the home and the brand impression (brief §8.5); the only high-quality slot.

_notes.download_status: blocked: curl -sI https://*.cloudfront.net → 403 from this environment (2026-09-30). Fix: claude.ai/code → environment → Network access: Custom → Allowed domains *.cloudfront.net.
_notes.consistency: Generate home-hero first and approve it; then keep camera language, site, trees, sun and materials of the conceptual 'Casa ARQ' constant for every slot that shows it (brief §15).
_notes.reject_if: impossible structure, changing building geometry between slots, cloned foliage, perfect CGI brick, wet reflections, resort landscaping, drone viewpoint, any person, any readable text.
_notes.placement: Convert with webimg (AVIF + WebP, explicit width/height, SEO names below), replace the CSS .brick placeholders by data-slot, lazy-load everything below the fold, preload only the hero, add og:image in includes/lib.php, show caption_required under every brand_concept image where it could be read as real work.
_notes.people: No people in any image (brief: no invented people; no one shown as a client).
